549-2034-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
549-2034-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Biotransference, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Biotransference, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Repeat from step 3.
549-2034-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

261-1981-2415-3967.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
261-1981-2415-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2438-3184-4766--190.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the non-Yomiji legendary creature.
Yomiji and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Yomiji trigger, returning the legendary card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting that card onto the battlefield from your hand and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder trigger.
Repeat.

5058-5968.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with toughness equal to 1.
5058-5968.description:
Cast Screams from Within by paying {1}{B}{B}, attaching it to a creature with toughness equal to 1.
The creature dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Ghostly Dancers and Screams from Within trigger.
Resolve the Ghostly Dancers trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Screams from Within trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the creature token
Repeat from step 2.

2034-3480-4289-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

431-4365-4772-7824.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-4365-4772-7824.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3062-3099-4762-7741.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Pir and Shang-Chi.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

413-4302-4875.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
413-4302-4875.description:
Activate Blasting Station by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Conspiracy, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2180-5231-6972.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Nearheath Stalker
When Nearheath Stalker dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Nearheath Stalker
When Nearheath Stalker dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Nearheath Stalker enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.
2180-5231-6972.notes: If Nearheath Stalker starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1233-3259-4460.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1233-3259-4460.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Squee as attackers.
Squee triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

455-1636-6972.notablePrerequisites: You are able to pay to cast Hoverguard Sweepers using any combination of mana-producing creatures and/or creatures that can reduce its cost using convoke.
455-1636-6972.description:
Cast Hoverguard Sweepers by paying its mana cost reduced by the number of creatures you can tap while casting it.
When Hoverguard Sweepers enters, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Hoverguard Sweepers trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
455-1636-6972.notes: If you control mana-producing creatures, you can tap those creatures for mana instead of tapping them using the convoke ability.

176-413-560.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional non-Spirit creature.
176-413-560.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a non-Spirit creature
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating two creature tokens due to Queen Allenal of Ruadach
When the creature tokens enter, Blasting Station triggers twice, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

4038-5457-5963.easyPrerequisites: Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
4038-5457-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Selvala's ability by tapping it, adding at least two mana.
Activate Marvin using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Marvin.
Repeat.
4038-5457-5963.notes: This combo produces infinite mana if you have creatures with at least three different powers.

250-779-1479-1669-3703.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-1669-3703.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Sporemound and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Thaumatog ability
Resolve the Sporemound trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Sporemound triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

967-997-2097-3809-7087.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

539-6797-7034.description:
Cast Bumi by paying its mana cost
When Bumi enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Bumi
When Bumi dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Bumi enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a film counter on it

2751-3649-6924.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls three nontoken creatures that they own and that are not commanders.
2751-3649-6924.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Etrata, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Etrata's trigger.
Holding priority, activate Peter Parker's Camera by paying {2}, removing a flim counter from it and tapping it, copying Etrata's trigger.
Resolve all Etrata triggers, exiling three creatures an opponent controls and putting hit counters on them, and then causing that opponent to lose the game.

4068-4251-6911.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Mountain.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
4068-4251-6911.description:
Declare Godo as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing you to untap it and all Samurai you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Godo, triggering Impostor Syndrome, creating a token copy of Godo that isn't legendary.
When the Godo token enters, it triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment and put it onto the battlefield.
During your next combat phase, declare Godo and the Godo token as attackers.
The Godo token triggers, causing you to untap it and all Samurai you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

628-2034-6863--133.notablePrerequisites: Blue has a -1/-1 counter on it.
628-2034-6863--133.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the other Dinosaur.
When the Dinosaur dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to the -1/-1 counter it will gain from Blue.
Repeat.
628-2034-6863--133.notes: The chosen Dinosaur must not be a Human for the combo to work. Notably, this means you cannot use a creature with changeling for this combo.

224-654-3147-3314-3430.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using three in any combination of {W} and/or {U}, and have the mana to cast it.
224-654-3147-3314-3430.description:
Cast the creature in your hand by paying its mana cost.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters, it, Amulet of Vigor and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Azorius Chancery.
Holding priority, activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}{U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from your hand to the battlefield.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Chulane.
Resolve the creature spell cast in step 1.
Activate Chulane by paying {3} and tapping it, returning the creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2067-2744.description:
Cast Storm Herd by paying {8}{W}{W}, creating a number of 1/1 Pegasus creature tokens equal to your life total.
When the Pegasi enter, Cathars' Crusade triggers that many times, putting that many +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
2067-2744.notes: The combo causes each creature you control as well as each Pegasus tokens to get a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to your life total as Storm Herd resolves.

2457-4321-4772-5794.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating four tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

2-2034-3000-5554.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}
Oltec Matterweaver triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a 1/1 Gnome artifact creature token.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Gnome and Squirrel, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Vehicle with MV >= 3 and a Crew Ability

2438-5747-6243--123.easyPrerequisites:
You have enough mana to cast the Vehicle with MV >= 3.
The number of artifacts you control is equal to or greater than the Vehicle's crew number minus 2.
2438-5747-6243--123.description:
Cast the Vehicle by paying its mana cost.
When the Vehicle enters the battlefield, Simulacrum Synthesizer triggers, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token that gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control.
Activate the Vehicle's crew ability by tapping the Construct, causing the Vehicle to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Vehicle.
When the Vehicle dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning the Vehicle from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not be an Angel because the Vehicle is no longer a creature and cannot gain creature types.
When the Vehicle enters the battlefield, Simulacrum Synthesizer triggers, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token that gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 3.

997-2781-2947.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Vesperlark.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Vesperlark.
When Vesperlark leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1339-2122-5231-6260.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1339-2122-5231-6260.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing an Insect, adding {R}.
Repeat.

4452-4508-5880-6441.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2557-4636-5770-6441.description:
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating four 6/6 Beast artifact creature tokens.
When the Beasts enter the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers four times, causing you to get eight {E}.
Repeat.

225-1479-4677-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You are able to play a land this turn.
225-1479-4677-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Zendikar's Roil trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Zendikar's Roil and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Zendikar's Roil triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1069-3156-4763-5173.notablePrerequisites: You control three or more artifacts, including an Equipment except Demonmail Hauberk.
1069-3156-4763-5173.description:
Activate an equipment except Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Shambling Ghast.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk by sacrificing Shambling Ghast, targeting Koll.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it and Koll trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Koll.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Shambling Ghast by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

372-3306-4477.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Slip On the Ring exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-3306-4477.description:
Cast Slip On the Ring by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Greenwarden of Murasa and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Greenwarden of Murasa trigger.
Resolve the Greenwarden of Murasa trigger, returning Slip On the Ring from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Slip On the Ring.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Greenwarden of Murasa and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1636-2470-4639-5251.description:
Activate Unctus by paying {U/P}, causing Emmara to become a blue artifact until end of turn.
Activate Grand Architect's second ability by tapping Emmara, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells and/or to activate abilities of artifacts.
Emmara triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to loot.
Resolve the second trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

58-4050-4424.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Goblin Taskmaster, adding {R}.
When Goblin Taskmaster dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Goblin Taskmaster from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Activate Goblin Taskmaster's morph ability by paying {R}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

2438-2523-2869.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Carrion Feeder that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

2436-3263-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Marwyn.
Marwyn does not have summoning sickness.
Marwyn has a power of at least two.
2436-3263-4222.description:
Activate Marwyn by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {1}, untapping Marwyn.
Repeat.

1769-2201-3025-3983.description:
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {5}{B}{B}.
Rot Hulk dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Rot Hulk's enter the battlefield trigger is put onto the stack.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger, returning Rot Hulk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

439-4050-4215.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Arashin Sovereign, adding one mana of any color.
Arashin Sovereign dies, triggering itself and Verdant Succession.
Resolve the Arashin Sovereign trigger, putting it on top of your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Arashin Sovereign, putting it onto the battlefield and shuffling your library.
Repeat.

568-4423-4872.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three additional Islands.
568-4423-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, getting an extra turn after this one.
Play Mystic Sanctuary to put Time Warp on top of your library.
Cast Capsize for its buyback cost by paying {4}{U}{U}, returning Mystic Sanctuary to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.

824-2228-2464.notablePrerequisites:
Song of Freyalise has one or two lore counters.
Leech Bonder does not have summoning sickness.
A creature you control has a -1/-1 counter on it.
824-2228-2464.description:
Activate Leech Bonder by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Leech Bonder by paying {U} and untapping it, moving a -1/-1 counter from a creature you control to any other creature you control.
Haptra triggers, creating a 1/1 Snake creature token.
Repeat.
